title: The Assyrian as God's Rod and Judgment on Pride
description: God uses the king of Assyria as a rod to punish His ungodly people, but the Assyrian does not understand that he is merely an instrument and boasts in his own strength and wisdom. When the Lord has finished His work on Zion, His wrath turns against the proud heart of the Assyrian, and the Lord of Hosts sends fire and wasting away to consume his glory so that only a few trees remain in his forest.
